C2.reason: Instituta has no user-organisation membership pivot: users reach organisations through principals. Adding a second membership table would create two sources of truth; organisations already use UUID primary keys.

C3.reason: Instituta authenticates local users and receives federation data through Brain principals; it has no user_identities table and no users.oidc_sub column.

C11.reason: api_keys uses its UUID primary key `id` as the public identifier; a separate `uuid` column would duplicate the key identifier. Every other C11 column and the dateTime types are present.

C21.reason: Content-Language negotiation is not implemented; locale is stored per user and UI strings are translated on the client.

C24.reason: X-Request-Id middleware is not implemented; request tracing currently relies on Laravel's request id in logs.

C25.reason: Idempotency-Key replay is not implemented for retryable API creates; callers currently rely on natural-key uniqueness.

C27.reason: Outbound webhooks are not part of the current product surface; Instituta does not emit Standard Webhooks envelopes yet.

C28.reason: Instituta's outbound HTTP calls still use Laravel Http/curl directly and do not yet route through the fleet SSRF pinning helper. Temporary security divergence; every call site is enumerated in https://github.com/qiick-io/instituta-core/issues/385.

C29.reason: Instituta does not use Spatie teams: organisation switching changes the principal scope and resolver context rather than a Spatie team id.
